highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews Skia m153 with the latest upstream renderer fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should review the updated fallback-face selection before adopting this preview.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to the m153 upstream line and includes the subsequent Chrome m153 bug-fix sync.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with Skia m153 and its latest upstream fixes, including updated Linux font fallback behavior.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It includes the current upstream m153 fixes and updates Linux font fallback selection.
